verdicts.reason: Both use the same structure and share its flaws: the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has moved below the subcopy, which breaks the reading order; there is a dead band of empty space above the headline; and the sneaker's left edge sits almost on the canvas edge, with a large gap before the CTA. A spaces the headline group more comfortably and centres its legal text under the centred CTA, although that text wraps awkwardly and leaves 'responsibly' alone on the second line. B crowds the headline, subcopy and eyebrow together, and its legal text is a single line that is barely legible and left-aligned, so it ignores the centred axis of the CTA.
